messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — enterprise prospect (healthtech) asking for a short pilot with a blended rate that mixes a reserved commit + overage credits. wants 1mo pilot, predictable unit pricing for budgeting. can product weigh in on acceptable guardrails?

alex_product: thanks @maria_sales. key questions: what commit size are they proposing? what's the expected token profile (seq len, qps, embedding vs gen)?

maria_sales: they proposed 1x A100-equivalent reserved for 1 month (~$Xk a month) + 200M token credit pool for overages. usage estimate: bursty batch seq gen, avg 150 tokens/request, peak ~120 rps for short windows. mostly text generation, some embeddings (10%).

dan_support: they'd be fine with canary traffic routing. main ask from them is simple billing line: per-token effective rate for the pilot so their FP&A can sign. they want to avoid complex line-items.

sarah_finance: important constraints: pilots must be revenue-protected (no negative unit economics). we can offer blended rate but need to cap total exposure. propose this formula for quoting: 
```
effective_rate = (commit_fee + expected_overage_cost) / expected_tokens
```
we need expected_tokens and a floor effective rate (min $/k tokens) to avoid loss.

trent_eng: implementation notes: offering a blended per-token invoice is billing-side only; runtime still enforces reserved capacity + overage usage. if we promise a predictable effective rate we need to ensure autoscale/fallback policy to avoid huge overruns — suggest explicit burst credit cap and automatic fallback to a lower-cost model if burst > X.

alex_product: launch/offer criteria we should be explicit about for the pilot: 1) commit size + duration, 2) burst credit cap, 3) SLA level (dedicated vs best-effort), 4) allowed models and quantization/optimizations, 5) measurable eval set to detect quality regressions. If sales wants a single per-token quote we attach an appendix showing how it's computed.

maria_sales: customer asks for a simple number to sign today. can we give them a one-page quote with these guardrails?

sarah_finance: yes, but with these caveats: pilot invoice will show line-items (commit fee, credits) internally; externally we can display an "effective rate" for their budgeting, and include a clause that final invoice may reconcile if usage deviations exceed 25%.

trent_eng: also want to call out lead time for provisioning dedicated capacity in their region is 7-10 business days. if they want same-day burst we need to rely on hosted spare capacity and a higher burst rate price.

pricing_bot: pricing calc suggestion: 
```
commit_fee = $12,000  # reserved pool for month
credit_value = $4,000  # 200M tokens at $0.02/1k
expected_tokens = 300_000_000
effective_rate_per_1k = (commit_fee + credit_value) / (expected_tokens/1000)  # ~$0.053/1k
```

alex_product: that's a reasonable starting point. product asks to capture this as a formal intake and prioritize in roadmap triage: - P2 pilot enablement (billing + guardrail docs) - add rollout playbook for blended-pilot offers - template quote + legal clause - capacity provisioning checklist

maria_sales: agreed. i'll attach customer LOI once they confirm. can product own the quote template?

alex_product: i'll create a backlog ticket with acceptance criteria: 1) template quote PDF + formula appendix, 2) internal billing reconciliation flow, 3) autoscale/fallback policy documented, 4) finance sign-off on floor rate, 5) SRE/infra checklist for provisioning. Target: ship deliverables as "pilot enablement" flag for next release.

dan_support: adding support runbook: contact points, throttles, how to rollback routing, and who to CC for capacity alerts.

sarah_finance: i'll review floor numbers and sign-off once you drop ticket.

maria_sales: timeline ask from customer: want quote today, pilot next week. given provisioning lead times, we should offer a hosted-backed pilot with reduced SLA and an option to migrate to dedicated.

trent_eng: confirm — hosted-backed pilot + migration path sounds safest. we'll need to tag migration as "planned maintenance" and include rollback plan.

alex_product: ok i'll draft the quote language now and open ticket. decision: offer hosted-backed 1mo pilot with blended external effective rate, internal line-item reconciliation, burst credit cap 200M tokens, migration path to dedicated if they commit long-term. prioritization: P2, start immediately.

maria_sales: awesome — please ping when ticket is up. i'll push the LOI. :pray:

pricing_bot: created draft pricing calc spreadsheet link: https://tiny.redwood/pricing-drafts/1853456789 (internal)

alex_product: ticket created: RDW-4521. assigning to @trent_eng, @sarah_finance, @dan_support. will post acceptance criteria in the ticket.

maria_sales: thanks all. keeping this thread for follow-ups.
